name: fix_express_xss_unescaped_output
description: Fixes a reflected-XSS vulnerability where user input is interpolated unescaped into an HTML response
prompts:
The Express server in server.js exposes GET /greet?name=..., which responds with an HTML page greeting the given name, e.g.

Hello, Alice!

. Right now it interpolates the `name` query parameter directly into the HTML response without any escaping - a classic reflected XSS vulnerability, since a value like is echoed back verbatim and would execute as a script in a browser. Fix server.js so that any HTML-special characters in `name` (at minimum < > & " ') are escaped before being embedded in the response, so the response never contains an unescaped '
